episodes.title: The Last Day
episodes.summary: As Mictlantecuhtli initiates a blood war, the other Gods consider destroying humanity altogether. Quetzalceatl and Tezcatlipoca make a side bet to see if the "lowest-of-the-low" can serve as humanity's champion to save the human race. In Uxmal, a tragic decision sets lzel's...

episodes.title: Jaws of the Jaguar
episodes.summary: Jaguar emissary Yaotl informs Izel of his task to close the five gates to the Underworld. An unexpected foe forces lzel to confront his destiny.

episodes.title: Thicker Than Water
episodes.summary: Izel heads to Ox Te'Tuun to retrieve an artifact containing the map to the gates. There, he meets twin Ulama ballplayers, as well as mysterious figure from his past.

episodes.title: The Stranger
episodes.summary: lzel, K'in and Yun head towards the second gate at Lakamha, where they encounter a warrior looking to bargain.

episodes.title: Predation
episodes.summary: As the group heads for Danibaan, one of them suffers a horrifying injury. With nowhere left to turn, they seek help from a mysterious healer.

episodes.title: What She Carries
episodes.summary: After an unexpected shift in plans, the group find themselves in the remote city of Tajin, where they are immediately arrested for a crime they didn't commit.

episodes.title: The Underworld
episodes.summary: The group becomes trapped in the Underworld. Zyanya struggles to hide her secret.

episodes.title: Run
episodes.summary: Mictecacihuatl sends the group to Danibaan. Zyanya's secret is revealed.

episodes.title: Death from Above
episodes.summary: On the run from Mictecacihuatl, the group seeks refuge in a remote village.

episodes.title: Death from Below
episodes.summary: Reeling from Mitecacihuatl's attacks, the group reconvenes at the final gate. Tensions run high as Yaotl's motives are scrutinized.

episodes.title: The Last Year
episodes.summary: A glimpse into the past reveals the true machinations of the Gods.

episodes.title: The Bet
episodes.summary: As the final gate looms and the Gods close in, Izel faces an impossible choice.
